title: Marketing Manager
company: Monroe and Chase Recruitment Specialists - Agency - Permanent
description:
Event Marketing Manager

£50,000 Loughton Full-time, office-based

Join an established and ambitious events business known for creating high-profile live experiences that bring industries, brands and audiences together. With a collaborative culture and a strong portfolio of events, the company offers an exciting environment where creative ideas, commercial thinking and great teamwork are valued.

The opportunity

An experienced Marketing Manager is required to take ownership of a high-profile B2 B event serving the construction and built-environment sector. You'll lead campaigns that grow registrations, strengthen market awareness and deliver measurable results.

Marketing Manager

This role calls for a commercially minded B2 B marketer who understands how to engage professional audiences. You'll create campaigns for contractors, developers, architects, specifiers, suppliers and other industry stakeholders, with a clear focus on increasing registrations, strengthening market presence and building valuable industry partnerships.

If you're a commercially minded event marketer who combines creativity with data, enjoys taking ownership and can confidently manage campaigns, budgets and industry stakeholders, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll do
- Own and deliver the marketing strategy for the event
- Drive professional registrations through integrated campaigns
- Manage digital, email, social, PR, partnerships and outdoor activity
- Lead campaign messaging, content and creative development
- Manage budgets, timelines, agencies and performance reporting
- Build strong relationships with sponsors, exhibitors and industry partners
- Use audience insight, CRM data and analytics to improve results
- Work closely with sales, content and operations teams

What you'll bring
- Proven marketing experience in exhibitions, conferences or live events
- Experience engaging B2 B or professional audiences
- A strong track record of registration growth and campaign conversion
- Excellent digital marketing, CRM, copywriting and creative skills
- Confidence managing budgets, agencies and multiple stakeholders
- A commercial, organised and hands-on approach

What's on offer
- £50,000 salary
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Access to a comprehensive staff benefits programme
- A supportive and collaborative events team
- The opportunity to shape the growth of a high-profile industry event

title: Brand Development Executive
description:
Job Title: Brand Development Executive - Health, Beauty & Wellness

Location: Kent, Sidcup (Office-based with flexibility once established)
Salary: £35,000 - £40,000 DOE + Company Bonus

Hours: 08.30am-5pm Monday to Friday (Flexibility if needed)

Are you someone who loves bringing brands to life and turning great products into commercial success stories? Do you thrive on coordinating campaigns, building supplier relationships, and creating marketing strategies that genuinely drive growth?

If this sounds like you, a leading health, beauty and wellness distribution business is looking for a Brand & Marketing Development Executive to take ownership of a growing portfolio of exciting brands.

About the Company

Our client is a respected distributor serving a nationwide network of independent pharmacy and retail customers. Working with a diverse portfolio of health, wellness and personal care brands, they help suppliers successfully launch, grow and position their products within the UK market. With ambitious growth plans and investment in both supplier partnerships and their own-brand portfolio, this is an exciting time to join the business.

What's the role about?

This is far more than a traditional marketing role.

You'll become the central point of contact between suppliers, internal stakeholders and external creative partners, ensuring brands have the strategy, visibility and support needed to succeed. You'll help shape launch plans, coordinate campaigns, manage social media activity and take ownership of a growing portfolio of brands.

You'll also play a key role in developing the company's own-label brands, helping to bring new products and ideas to market.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and coordinate marketing plans for supplier and own-label brands.
- Manage a rolling promotional calendar across email campaigns, websites, catalogues and other marketing channels.
- Coordinate product launches from concept through to market execution.
- Build strong relationships with suppliers, acting as the key point of contact for marketing activity and approvals.
- Work alongside sales teams to identify commercial opportunities and maximise brand visibility.
- Manage and grow social media channels, including LinkedIn, Instagram and other relevant platforms.
- Brief and coordinate external creative resources, ensuring campaigns are delivered on time and to brand standards.
- Monitor campaign effectiveness and recommend improvements based on results.

Support artwork, packaging and creative updates using tools such as Canva and Adobe Creative Suite.

Requirements

About You

We're looking for someone who combines creativity with commercial awareness and enjoys taking ownership.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in brand management, marketing, campaign coordination or a similar role.
- Strong project management and organisational skills.
- Experience working with multiple stakeholders, suppliers or brands simultaneously.
- Knowledge of social media marketing and campaign execution.
- Experience using Canva and ideally Adobe Creative Suite.
- A commercial and creative mindset, with the confidence to work independently.
- B2 B marketing experience, ideally within FMCG, healthcare, wellness, personal care, ecommerce or a related sector.
- A genuine interest in health, beauty, wellness or consumer products.

Benefits

What's in it for you?
- Take ownership of your own portfolio of brands and influence their growth.
- Work with innovative health, wellness and personal care products entering the UK market.
- Be part of a newly created role with genuine opportunity to shape processes and strategy.
- Enjoy a broad role combining brand management, marketing, supplier engagement and creative input.
- Join a collaborative, growing business where your ideas will be heard and valued.

Ready to make an impact?

If you're looking for a role where you can take ownership, influence brand growth, and work on exciting product launches within a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or get in touch for a confidential discussion about this opportunity.

title: Paid Media Lead
description:
Paid Media Lead - PPC Kingdom

Location: Bromley, London - office-based, with hybrid working opportunities.

Hours: Full-time

About PPC Kingdom

PPC Kingdom is a dynamic digital marketing agency specialising in paid search and paid social, tracking and analytics, SEO, graphic design and website development.

We deliver campaign management, auditing and consultancy across the UK, Europe, US and LATAM. Our clients span e-commerce and retail, gambling, travel, legal and professional services, tax, EV charging and automotive, sport, education, construction and trades, and multi-site consumer services.

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Paid Media Lead to own paid media strategy and performance across a varied client portfolio.

You will manage accounts from end to end; planning and campaign delivery to tracking, testing, ad copy and visuals, reporting and client communication. You will combine analytical thinking with creativity and initiative to solve problems, resolve tracking issues and demonstrate what drives results.

Key responsibilities
- Own a portfolio of client accounts across the UK and international markets.
- Develop and implement paid media strategies aligned with client objectives and budgets, including audits, plans and strategy documents for new and existing accounts.
- Design, build, launch, monitor and optimise Google Ads campaigns across Search, Performance Max, Shopping and YouTube.
- Plan and run full-funnel Meta campaigns, from awareness through to lead generation and sales.
- Run campaigns on other relevant platforms, including LinkedIn, Reddit, Snapchat, TikTok and emerging platforms such as ChatGPT Ads.
- Conduct keyword, audience and competitor research to inform campaign decisions.
- Review search terms, manage negative keywords and audit account structures.
- Manage budgets and bidding strategies against ROAS, CPA and lead targets, monitoring spend and identifying opportunities to improve performance.
- Set up and troubleshoot GA4, Google Tag Manager and Google Tag Gateway on WordPress, Shopify and Wix sites. Use platform data to monitor performance, assess conversion tracking and investigate issues.
- Manage consent mode and cookie banner configurations.
- Design, run and analyse tests to measure the incremental impact of paid media.
- Translate campaign data into clear insights and practical recommendations through monthly reports, quarterly performance reviews and Looker Studio dashboards.
- Act as clients' day-to-day contact, build strong relationships and clearly explain results, recommendations and next steps.
- Ensure campaign quality, stay up to date with platform changes and share knowledge with colleagues.

Essential skills, experience and qualifications
- At least 3 years of hands-on digital marketing experience, including work within a digital marketing agency.
- Proven hands-on experience managing paid media campaigns independently, from planning and launch to reporting and optimisation.
- Proficiency in Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, Apple Search Ads and LinkedIn Ads.
- Strong Google Ads skills across Search, Performance Max and Shopping, plus experience running full-funnel Meta campaigns.
- Proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM), including performance analysis, conversion tracking and the confidence to implement and troubleshoot tracking.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills, with a commercial focus on ROAS, CPA and lead quality, and the ability to translate findings into campaign improvements.
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
- Excellent written and spoken English, strong ad copywriting and client communication skills, and the confidence to lead client calls and explain results to non-specialists.
- Experience using CMS and e-commerce platforms such as WordPress, Shopify or Wix.
- Relevant industry certifications, such as Google Skillshop and Meta Blueprint.
- A bachelor's degree in marketing, a similar subject or a related mathematical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities and deadlines independently.
- The right to work in the UK and the ability to work on site at our Bromley office.

Desirable skills and experience
- Practical graphic design experience creating advertising assets with Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator and Canva.
- Working knowledge of SEO principles and experience using tools such as SEMrush, Moz or Screaming Frog.
- Experience running campaigns on Reddit, TikTok or ChatGPT Ads.
- Knowledge of Google Merchant Centre, Shopping feeds and Meta Advantage+ shopping campaigns.
- Experience with incrementality or holdout testing.
- Experience using Looker Studio.
- Experience working in regulated sectors such as gambling, legal or financial services.
- Experience running campaigns in more than one country or language.

What we are looking for

You take ownership, follow through on commitments and enjoy understanding the numbers behind campaign performance. You approach challenges with curiosity, initiative and practical solutions, combining analytical thinking with creativity. You communicate confidently, build positive relationships with clients and colleagues, welcome feedback and actively develop your skills.

What we offer
- A salary of up to £45,000 per annum, depending on experience.
- 25 days' annual leave, plus an additional day off for your birthday.
- Workplace pension auto-enrolment in line with UK requirements.
- Opportunities for hybrid working after three months.
- The opportunity to help shape the future of a growing digital marketing agency.
- Opportunities to attend international conferences.
- All applicable statutory employment benefits.

title: Account Manager (Affiliate Marketing)
description:
Purpose of position

Our Key Account Management team is looking for an Account Manager to come and work on the affiliate programmes for advertisers across a various range of sectors. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your analytical and strategic skills. You will act as a point of contact for clients on the Awin network, advising on best practice and offering recommendations on optimising affiliate programmes. As an active member of the team, you will implement strategies for improving their account, offering guidance and training throughout this process. The role involves devising innovative and new account management ideas to help grow affiliate revenues for your client, and across the Account Management team. AMT sits in Managed Services, which means we take a proactive approach with our clients. You are the expert!

You will have exposure to an extensive range of brands, receive in-depth training across multiple subjects, and have the opportunity to collaborate on wider projects. The role will involve bringing innovation and strategy to your clients and maintaining engagement with clients and publishers alike in order to deliver sophisticated results. As a result, this role is perfect for anyone looking to push forward their career within a fast-paced and dynamic industry.

Key Tasks
- Deliver excellent service and relationship management to clients and agencies across accounts in your remit
- Be the internal owner of all assigned accounts and be fully informed and able to provide information when required, to include metrics, objectives and status
- Generating reports and providing analysis on performance, and ensuring commentary is accurate and insightful with a view at improving activity
- Taking ownership of and streamlining processes
- Regular client calls and the ability to be reactive and supportive of client goals
- Initiate and implement ideas to grow affiliate activities in line with the needs of clients and assist clients in the creation of quarterly and yearly strategies
- Producing competitor benchmarks for your clients, while proactively advising on industry trends and identifying opportunities for merchants
- Take 100% ownership of assigned accounts delivery and service levels and pro-actively providing insight to Team Leader
- Building relevant and comprehensive client roadmaps to help achieve success
- Optimising existing publisher relationships and recruiting new and exciting publisher opportunities for advertisers
- Presenting confidently, both internally and externally, on a range of topics.
- Ensuring that you and your clients are up to date with all technology and tracking optimisations, and that all campaigns make the best use of these

Skills & Expertise
- Enthusiastic, committed, and passionate about digital
- 1+ years' account management experience in a relevant digital marketing role
- Numerate with a good level of knowledge of MS Office packages
- Ability to see the bigger picture and identify areas of opportunity and risk
- Professional and with a proven track record of successful client and team relationship building, including strong networking skills
- Seeks ownership and readily accepts accountability
- Strong time management and organizational skills to maintain own work flow and meet deadlines
- Confident and excellent communicator with a keen attention to detail

Our Offer
- Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
- Flexi-Office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid working model, designed to foster collaboration, trust, and autonomy.
- Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace at home.
- Pension: We make regular contributions to support your retirement savings.
- Private Medical Insurance: Comprehensive coverage for a range of health, vision and dental treatments.
- Electric Vehicle & Cycle to Work Schemes: Save on commuting costs through tax-efficient schemes for electric vehicle leasing and bike purchase.
- Workplace Nursery Benefit: Save on childcare costs through a salary sacrifice scheme with tax and National Insurance savings. In addition, you'll benefit from our global offering, including health and wellbeing initiatives, learning and development via Awin Academy, and peer-to-peer recognition programmes.

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we've had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world's leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Awin is part of the Axel Springer group.Learn more at , and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here:

Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development.

title: Accounts Assistant - Media & Advertising
description:
Are you an Accounts Assistant or Finance Assistant looking to work for a rapidly growing Global Communications and PR business? Are you looking to work in a newly created role with excellent learning and progression opportunities on offer? This rapidly growing international public relations group are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Accounts Assistant / Finance Assistant to help deliver accurate and timely day-to-day accounting support to assist with the firms growth. Reporting directly to the Financial Controller, specific responsibilities will include: processing supplier invoices and employee expense claims, managing accounts payable and supplier queries, raising sales invoices and supporting credit control activities, posting bank entries and performing bank reconciliations, supporting payroll administration and employee finance queries, maintaining accurate accounting records and supporting audit requests, supporting the Financial Controller with monthly finance processes and reporting tasks and ad hoc tasks and projects as required. Your duties and responsibilities will increase over time as your role develops and progresses as the business grows.The firm offers hybrid working - 3 days in the office and 2 days home working. The firm use Sage and Excel although full training on both packages can be provided.

To be considered for this newly created role (October 2026) you must be an Accounts Assistant or Finance Assistant or currently working in practice and looking to make your first move into industry. You must have at least 2 - 3 years relevant finance experience, with strong bookkeeping and journal entry experience and knowledge of areas such as Purchase Ledger, Sales Ledger and Bank reconciliations. Experience of Sage would be an advantage but not essential. You must also be a team player, sociable, and ambitious with aspirations to progress and take on more responsibility in a short space of time.

This newly created position represents an excellent opportunity for someone to be part of a global international PR & communications Group and allow your career to grow with the business. The firm is growing at a rapid rate due to business acquisitions and so there will be plenty of opportunities for progression and increased responsibility. The firm is very sociable with a great work culture and a very low staff turnover as all staff enjoy long term careers at the firm. This role would suit someone looking to stay somewhere long term and work in a professional and friendly setting. The firm offers hybrid working and a very generous benefits package.

title: Amazon Marketplace and PPC Executive
description:
The Opportunity

We are recruiting an Amazon Marketplace and PPC Executive to take hands-on commercial ownership of our Amazon channel and drive profitable sales growth. This is not a PPC-only position; the successful candidate will be responsible for Amazon sales performance, advertising, listings, organic ranking, conversion, pricing, promotions, stock availability and product launches.

What Will You Bring

Strong practical Amazon Marketplace and Seller Central experience, proven PPC capability and a track record of growing Amazon sales. You will be commercially minded, confident with performance data and proactive in turning insight into action. Experience with Excel or Google Sheets and AI-assisted content and analysis is important.

Full Job Description Original Wording Retained

Role Purpose

Own the Amazon channel end-to-end and deliver profitable sales growth. This is not a PPC-only role; the successful candidate will be accountable for Amazon sales, listings, organic ranking, conversion, pricing, promotions, PPC, stock availability and product launches. The role is suited to someone who is highly driven by sales numbers, acts quickly on performance data and takes ownership of the Amazon result.

Key Responsibilities

Sales and Commercial Performance:
- Own weekly, monthly and annual Amazon sales targets and growth plans.
- Monitor sales, orders, units, average selling price, conversion and contribution performance.
- Identify winning SKUs to scale and underperforming SKUs requiring action.
- Monitor competitor pricing, promotions, rankings and category activity.
- Build and manage the Amazon trading calendar, including Prime events, Black Friday, Christmas and other key trading periods.
- Recommend pricing, coupons, promotions and deal activity within the approved commercial framework.

Amazon PPC:
- Own Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and relevant display / remarketing campaigns.
- Manage keywords, search terms, targeting, bids, budgets and campaign testing.
- Optimise ACOS, TACOS, ROAS and PPC sales while supporting total Amazon growth.
- Use PPC data to identify organic keyword opportunities and improve listings.
- Align ad spend with stock availability, launches and promotional priorities.

Listings, SEO and Conversion:
- Optimise titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, images, videos and A+ content where relevant.
- Improve organic visibility, keyword ranking and conversion rate.
- Monitor reviews, ratings, Buy Box and account-health issues.
- Work with Product / PIM and Creative teams to ensure listings are complete, accurate and commercially strong.

Stock, Forecasting and Product Launches:
- Monitor Amazon stock availability and identify out-of-stock or excess-stock risks early.
- Work with Product / Buying on demand trends, launch quantities and promotional stock requirements.
- Work with Customer Fulfilment on Linnworks, FBA / 3 PL and stock-discrepancy issues.
- Own Amazon launch execution for new products, including listing readiness, keyword strategy, PPC setup, pricing and early performance optimisation.

Research, Reporting and Action:
- Conduct keyword, search-demand, competitor and category research.
- Provide concise weekly reporting covering sales, conversion, traffic, PPC, ranking, stock risks and actions.
- Every review should answer: What happened Why did it happen What are we doing next

AI-Assisted Creative and Productivity:
- Use approved AI tools to create or adapt Amazon listing and campaign assets, including draft lifestyle concepts, creative variations and promotional visuals.
- Use AI to support copy ideation, keyword research, competitor analysis and performance insight generation.
- Create multiple creative versions for testing while maintaining product accuracy and brand consistency.
- Work with the Content and Creative Marketing Executive to ensure final assets meet channel and brand requirements.

Key Performance Indicators:
- Amazon sales £ and sales growth %
- Orders / units and sales vs target
- Contribution / profitable growth
- Conversion rate and traffic
- Organic keyword ranking
- PPC sales, ACOS, TACOS and ROAS
- In-stock rate and stock-out risk
- Listing completeness and launch readiness
- Promotion and new-product launch performance

Candidate Profile:
- Strong hands-on Amazon Marketplace and Seller Central experience.
- Proven Amazon PPC experience with evidence of commercial results.
- Demonstrated ability to grow Amazon sales, not just optimise advertising metrics.
- Strong understanding of ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, conversion and keyword / search-term performance.
- Strong Excel / Google Sheets analytical skills.
- Confident using AI tools for creative asset production, copy ideation, research and analysis.
- Highly proactive, commercially minded and comfortable taking ownership of targets.
- Able to balance sales growth, stock availability and profitability.
- Strong cross-functional communication and problem-solving skills.

Success in the Role

I own the Amazon number.

The successful person understands what is driving the Amazon result, what is holding it back, and what actions are required to grow it profitably.

title: Digital Marketing Executive - Remote
description:
Digital Marketing Executive - Part-Time, Remote

Recruiter: E Junior Recruitment, on behalf of Stats Profit

Location: Fully Remote (UK)

Hours: 5 hours per week, flexible

Pay: £15 per hour (£75 per week / £300 every four weeks)

Contract: Initial 3-6 months, with potential to extend

About Stats Profit

E Junior Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of Stats Profit, a specialist, data-driven football tipster service.

Using historical football data dating back to 2014, Stats Profit applies predefined statistical criteria to identify qualifying home-win selections across 11 European football leagues.

Paying members receive football selections, reference odds and performance tracking information to help them follow a structured betting strategy.

Annual membership currently costs £495. The system has recorded historically profitable results, although betting carries financial risk and future profitability is not guaranteed.

The Opportunity

We're seeking a creative, ambitious and resourceful individual to help solve one of Stats Profit's biggest commercial challenges: attracting new customers and building a sustainable paying membership base.

The business faces three significant challenges:

1. Starting Almost From Scratch

Stats Profit currently has just ONE active paying member. Despite having an established methodology and historical performance records, the business has very limited brand awareness and no substantial existing customer acquisition pipeline.

2. A Seasonal Product

Football selections are primarily available between August and May, with a summer off-season when no live selections are provided. This creates an additional challenge in attracting, engaging and converting potential customers throughout the year.

3. No Marketing Budget

There is NO separate marketing or advertising budget. The business cannot currently fund paid advertising, sponsorships, purchased leads or premium marketing tools.

The successful candidate must therefore develop and implement an organic marketing strategy using existing resources and free opportunities.

The Challenge

How would you build Stats Profit's audience and paying membership base organically, starting almost from scratch, with a seasonal product and no marketing budget?

We don't have a predetermined solution.

We're looking for someone capable of independently researching the business, understanding its potential customers and developing an original, commercially realistic approach.

We value fresh thinking, creativity, initiative and practical problem-solving over qualifications or years of marketing experience.

Key Responsibilities
- Research and understand Stats Profit, its business model and potential customers.
- Independently develop an organic customer acquisition strategy.
- Identify and assess opportunities to attract relevant prospective customers.
- Implement, test and refine agreed marketing initiatives.
- Consider the challenges of the seasonal football calendar.
- Monitor performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Provide a brief weekly progress report covering activity, results and next steps.
- Ensure marketing activity complies with relevant laws and responsible gambling advertising requirements.

Who We're Looking For

We're particularly interested in individuals who:
- Have a genuine passion for marketing, business growth or creative problem-solving.
- Enjoy researching specialist markets and understanding customer behaviour.
- Can develop original ideas and explain why they believe those ideas could work.
- Have strong initiative, resourcefulness and commercial awareness.
- Are confident working independently with minimal supervision.
- Can translate their ideas into practical activity.
- Are motivated by the opportunity to help build a small business.

An interest in football, statistics or betting would be advantageous but is not essential.

Previous professional marketing experience is NOT required.

Applications are welcomed from students, graduates, aspiring marketers and individuals with relevant practical experience.

Recruitment Process

Our recruitment process consists of two stages:

Stage 1 - Informal Zoom Interview

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an informal Zoom conversation to discuss their background, interests, motivation and understanding of the opportunity.

This is an opportunity for both parties to get to know each other and explore whether the role could be a good fit.

No presentation is required at this stage.

Stage 2 - Marketing Strategy Presentation

Candidates progressing from the initial interview will be invited to deliver a 10-minute presentation.

The presentation will address the following challenge:

"With one active paying member, a £495 annual subscription, a seasonal service and absolutely no marketing budget, how would you build Stats Profit's organic audience and convert relevant interest into paying memberships?"

We want to understand your independent thinking, the reasoning behind your proposed approach, how you would implement it and what you believe could realistically be achieved.

There is no predetermined answer, and we encourage candidates to challenge conventional thinking.

Why Join Stats Profit?

This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of a business challenge rather than simply follow a predefined marketing plan.

You'll benefit from flexible remote working, the freedom to develop and test your own ideas and the opportunity to gain meaningful commercial experience.

The initial contract will run for 3-6 months, with the potential for a longer-term opportunity depending on business needs and performance.

title: Growth Marketing & Demand Generation Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced Growth Marketing & Demand Generation Manager with a track record in data services, technology, utilities or telecoms, to join our marketing team. This is not a first marketing management role or an entry point into demand generation - we are looking for someone who has already built a solid track record in growth marketing or demand generation who wants to build on that experience here at Sagacity, taking ownership of the campaigns and activity that drive our pipeline.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, you will work closely with our Marketing Associate, Sales, Product, Innovation and Delivery Teams.

You will take the lead on growth and demand generation - including pipeline revenue, detailed campaign planning, design and delivery, and account-based marketing (ABM) for our key target accounts - while contributing to wider marketing strategy, positioning, brand and paid media decisions alongside the rest of the team.

Note: both the industry experience and the minimum years of experience below are firm requirements and we are unable to consider applications from candidates without demonstrable, hands-on growth marketing or demand generation experience, or from candidates whose experience sits outside the sectors listed above.

Principal responsibilities:
- Own and execute Sagacity's growth and demand generation activity, taking accountability for pipeline revenue contribution and reporting progress against targets
- Own the detailed planning and delivery of multi-channel campaigns - across email, digital, social and content - that generate awareness, engagement and qualified pipeline
- Own account-based marketing (ABM) programmes for target accounts across our core sector, working closely with the Sales team to align messaging, targeting and outreach
- Manage campaign activity in HubSpot - building workflows, landing pages, email journeys, lead and nurture programmes and reporting dashboards
- Work alongside the Marketing Associate to plan and deliver campaigns, events and content, ensuring growth and demand generation priorities are planned and delivered
- Contribute to paid media planning (SEM and paid social) to ensure activity aligns with growth and demand generation priorities
- Contribute to marketing strategy and planning, including the annual timetable of events, and to company and product positioning and proposition work
- Contribute ideas and alignment on brand identity, sales and marketing collateral, thought leadership, press and PR, website content and SEO, events and webinars, and organic social, working closely with the wider marketing and creative teams
- Track, analyse and report on campaign and pipeline performance, making data-led recommendations to improve results
- Contribute to marketing budgeting and reporting
- Use and maintain proficiency across Sagacity's sales and marketing tooling, including HubSpot, LinkedIn, AMP (Jam 7), So Ampli, In Design and our AI-assisted design tools
- Maintain awareness of market and competitor activity, keeping up to date with sector trends and the competitive landscape

What we're looking for

Essential:
- At least 3 years' hands-on experience in growth marketing, demand generation or B2 B campaign management, gained within data services, technology, utilities or telecoms
- A proven track record of owning campaign planning and delivery end-to-end, with clear evidence of contribution to pipeline and revenue
- Experience running or contributing to account-based marketing (ABM) programmes
- Practical experience with HubSpot or an equivalent CRM / Sales / Marketing automation platforms, including workflows, landing pages and reporting
- A working understanding of paid media/SEM and how it supports demand generation activity
- Strong analytical skills, comfortable using data and campaign metrics to inform decisions and report on performance
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and confidence collaborating with Sales, Product and Commercial teams as well as the wider marketing team
- Highly organised, with strong planning and prioritisation skills and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines at once
- Commercially minded and passionate about how marketing activity translates into pipeline and revenue
- Have a keen eye for detail
- Have pride in your deliverables
- Good at working independently and as part of a team
- Are flexible, self-motivated and calm under pressure
- Have a commitment to personal development
- Have the right to work in the UK

Desirable:
- A marketing qualification - Degree or Professional Qualification (e.g. CIM)
- Experience with account-based marketing platforms or sales enablement/employee advocacy tools (e.g. So Ampli, Jam 7)
- Exposure to AI-assisted marketing or design tooling
- Experience working with external agencies
- Event or webinar planning experience

title: HubSpot Funnel & Conversion Marketing Manager - Travel Franchise
description:
Revenue Funnels HubSpot Sales Psychology Marketing Automation CRO

Great marketing doesn t just generate leads. It understands what makes people buy.

Why does someone click but not enquire? What makes a prospect book a call? What messaging builds trust, overcomes objections and turns curiosity into a buying decision?

And can you personally build a funnel that turns those insights into results?

We re The Travel Franchise, the UK s leading travel franchise, voted Best Lifestyle Franchise in the World two years running. We already generate thousands of enquiries every month. Now we need a commercially sharp, technically brilliant, hands-on funnel specialist to turn that interest into qualified opportunities and new franchise owners.

This isn t about building automations to a brief. It s about understanding the audience, developing the strategy, writing persuasive messaging, building the entire funnel and continually testing what works.

If you love the psychology of selling as much as the technology behind it, we d love to meet you.

The Role at a Glance

HubSpot Funnel & Conversion Marketing Manager
Remote - UK Bournemouth Preferred for Occasional Collaboration
Competitive Salary DOE + Bonus
Permanent Full Time

Pedigree: UK s Leading Travel Franchise Best Lifestyle Franchise in the World Two Years Running

Your Background / Skills: HubSpot (5+ Years), Revenue Funnels, Marketing Automation, Sales Copywriting, Direct Response Marketing, Sales Psychology, CRO, Lead Nurture, Landing Pages, WordPress, Elementor, A/B Testing

The Role a Year From Now

Your first year will have been a success if you ve delivered these three outcomes:

More qualified franchise opportunities: You ve improved how we convert existing interest into booked conversations, qualified enquiries and new franchise owners.

High-performing revenue funnels: You ve personally built sophisticated HubSpot funnels that guide prospects through a longer, considered buying journey with compelling messaging, intelligent automation and timely follow-up.

Measurable conversion improvements: You ve continually tested and refined landing pages, copy, campaigns and nurture sequences, using performance data to lift conversion and commercial results.

This Role

This is a genuinely hands-on, commercially focused funnel-building role. We re not looking for someone to manage HubSpot, oversee agencies or implement campaigns designed by somebody else. We need someone who can spot a commercial opportunity, understand the audience and independently work out how to turn interest into action.

Buying a travel franchise is a significant personal and financial decision. Prospects may spend weeks or months researching and weighing up their options. So the marketing journey needs to do far more than capture an email address: it must build trust, create desire, address objections and move people towards a conversation with our sales team.

You ll make that happen, from messaging and copy to landing pages, HubSpot workflows and conversion testing. Working closely with our marketing team and Co-Founders, you ll have the freedom to challenge assumptions and introduce new ideas.

What You ll Be Working On

Building complete revenue funnels: Designing and personally building multi-step HubSpot funnels that move prospects from initial interest to qualified sales opportunity.

Creating persuasive messaging: Writing landing-page copy, email sequences, headlines and CTAs that connect with the audience s motivations and buying psychology.

Understanding the buying journey: Identifying what prospects need to hear, see and experience at each stage of a high-value, longer-consideration sale.

Developing intelligent automations: Building complex workflows, behavioural triggers, segmentation, lead scoring and nurture sequences that respond to prospect intent.

Creating high-converting landing pages: Building and improving pages in WordPress and Elementor.

Testing and optimising relentlessly: Experimenting with messaging, offers, layouts, CTAs, timing and funnel structures to find what genuinely improves conversion.

Improving lead quality: Working with the sales team to understand which enquiries convert and where prospects drop off.

Personalising the experience: Using RightMessage, HubSpot and AI to deliver more relevant content and journeys.

Owning the results: Analysing funnel performance and making ongoing improvements based on qualified leads, booked calls and revenue opportunities.

Here s the Experience We re Looking For

You ll be an experienced, hands-on HubSpot specialist with strong commercial and creative instincts, bringing:
- 5+ years of substantial, hands-on HubSpot experience, confidently building sophisticated automations, workflows, funnels, segmentation, nurture sequences and reporting yourself.
- Proven experience building complex, high-converting sales funnels, ideally for high-value products or services with consultative buying journeys.
- Strong sales copywriting skills: compelling headlines, landing pages, email sequences and CTAs that persuade people to take the next step.
- A genuine understanding of sales psychology: motivations, objections, trust-building and persuasion.
- The ability to develop and execute your own ideas without someone mapping out every campaign.
- Extensive testing and optimisation experience, with examples of what your improvements delivered commercially.
- Confidence in creating landing pages and campaign assets yourself, ideally in WordPress and Elementor.
- Strong commercial awareness: you know the difference between generating leads and generating qualified opportunities that convert into revenue.
- Excellent written and spoken English.
- A proactive, hands-on approach: you re happiest getting into the platforms and making things happen.
- Experience with RightMessage, website personalisation, AI-driven marketing tools and integrations would be highly beneficial.

Most importantly, we want someone who can show us what they ve personally built, why they built it that way, how they improved it and what it achieved.

Why Join Us?

You ll own one of the most commercially important areas of our marketing, work directly with decision makers, have the freedom to experiment and see the commercial impact of your work.

Salary: Competitive, depending on experience.
Performance Bonus: Rewards linked to business performance.
Professional Development: Dedicated learning budget.
Holiday & Travel: Generous holiday allowance plus genuine travel opportunities.
Culture: Netflix-inspired Freedom & Responsibility context not control, outcomes over hours.

Who Are We?

Not Just Travel and The Travel Franchise are multi-award-winning travel companies with over 700 active Travel Consultants across the UK. Our unique B2 B2 C model lets franchisees build successful travel businesses, backed by our marketing, systems, training and infrastructure. Marketing plays a central role in connecting the right people with that opportunity.

If you love building sophisticated funnels, understand what makes people buy and get a buzz from improving conversion, we d love to hear from you.

Ready to Join Us?
Application notice We take your privacy seriously. As you might expect you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. Your data is processed by our talent partner RR (Recruitment Revolution) on the basis of their legitimate interests in fulfilling the recruitment process. Please refer to their Data Privacy Policy & Notice on their website for further details.

title: Internal Communications Executive
description:
Job Title: Internal Communications Executive

Location: London

Salary: £30,000-37,000

Job Type: Permanent, Full Time

Closing Date: 10th November 2026

About SYNLAB:

Our people support pathology services that matter to patients, clinicians and communities. Your work will help the Internal Communications team connect colleagues across our headquarters and four hospital businesses.

As part of our Marketing & Communications team, you will work alongside specialists in internal, corporate, service-user and social communications. You will support colleagues on a broad mix of activity and gain exposure to senior stakeholders and functions including Operations, IT, Quality, Health and Safety, Finance, People, Learning and Development, Recruitment and scientific development.

You will join us at an important stage in the development of our communications channels, including the launch of a UK&I-wide intranet. You will help deliver these improvements by coordinating activity, creating content, gathering feedback and contributing ideas. You will have the support and direction of experienced colleagues while being trusted to take responsibility for your work and follow tasks through to completion.

About the Role:

Can you turn complex business updates into communications that people genuinely want to read, watch and act on?

We are looking for an experienced Internal Communications Executive to provide creative and practical support to our Internal Communications team. You will help us keep more than 3,000 colleagues across SYNLAB UK&I informed, connected and clear about our strategy, priorities and the part they play in our success.

Working within agreed plans and priorities, you will turn ideas into action by creating audience-focused content, coordinating activity and supporting campaigns across our channels. You will be trusted to manage your own workload, take initiative and keep projects moving, while working closely with the Internal Communications Manager and wider Communications team.

Based at our Blackfriars Hub three days a week, with travel to other SYNLAB businesses across the UK, you will join a collaborative team of nine. If you have relevant experience and want to broaden your skills through varied, hands-on work, this role will give you the opportunity to contribute ideas, support high-profile projects and make a visible difference to how colleagues experience communications.

Working under the direction of the Internal Communications Manager, you will support the planning, coordination and delivery of communications across the organisation.

You will manage the communications calendar, coordinate requests, track actions and approvals, and help ensure timely, well-sequenced communications. Working across multiple priorities, you will create and publish content for the intranet, newsletters, digital signage, town halls, presentations and video, while supporting key employee campaigns and initiatives.

You will also help engage colleagues in laboratory and other non-desk-based roles, gathering feedback and ensuring communications reach all audiences effectively.

What You Will Do:
- Deliver timely, accurate and engaging internal communications, effectively managing competing priorities, stakeholder requests and deadlines while supporting the Internal Communications Manager and wider Communications team to achieve business objectives.
- Maintain and continuously develop internal communication channels, including the intranet, newsletters, digital signage, town halls and other employee communication platforms, ensuring content is consistent, relevant and engaging.
- Own and manage the internal communications calendar, coordinating content, campaigns and key messaging across the business.
- Create, write, coordinate and deliver internal communications campaigns that support organisational priorities, projects and initiatives, including DE&I, ESG, appraisal cycles and employee recognition programmes.
- Build strong relationships and networks across the organisation to proactively identify, develop and share engaging employee, business and customer stories.
- Collaborate with internal and external communications colleagues to maximise content and engagement opportunities arising from events, conferences, awards, town halls, site visits and other key activities.
- Support the planning, promotion and delivery of employee engagement and listening activities, helping to increase participation and awareness across the organisation.
- Use audience insight, campaign measurement and reporting tools to evaluate communications effectiveness, share learnings and drive continuous improvement.
- Produce clear, compelling and audience-focused content, tailoring messages and channels to maximise impact and engagement.
- Identify innovative ways to engage a predominantly laboratory-based workforce with limited access to digital communication tools during working hours.
- Provide communications support during major incidents, ensuring timely and effective dissemination of information when required.
- Represent Internal Communications at cross-functional meetings, building effective stakeholder relationships and promoting best practice communication approaches.
- Act as a passionate ambassador for SYNLAB, supporting the delivery of consistent messaging and helping colleagues understand and engage with the organisation's strategic direction.
- Work effectively at pace, managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy.

Additional Information:

Please click on the APPLY button to send your CV and Cover Letter for this role.

Candidates with experience of; Internal Content Strategy Manager, Corporate Communications Manager, Internal Communications Specialist, Employee Engagement Manager, Internal Brand Manager, Workplace Communications Lead, Internal Communications Director, Internal Communications Business Partner, may also be considered for this role.

title: Senior Retail Marketing Manager EMEA
description:
Senior Retail Marketing Manager EMEA London Consumer Electronics

An opportunity to shape retail growth across EMEA for a fast-growing, global consumer technology business.
We're looking for an experienced Senior Retail Marketing Manager to lead retail channel marketing across EMEA, working at the intersection of brand, retail, commercial and customer experience.

This is a high-impact role for someone who understands that great retail marketing is about far more than simply creating campaigns. You'll work closely with some of the region's leading retail partners and distributors, building strong relationships and ensuring that marketing programmes, in-store experiences and brand activations translate into measurable commercial results.

With the business continuing to expand rapidly across international markets, this is an exciting time to join. You'll have the opportunity to help shape how the brand shows up across EMEA retail and play a key role in building the next stage of its growth.

The Role

As Senior Retail Marketing Manager, you'll take ownership of the development and execution of EMEA retail marketing programmes, partnering closely with Sales, Creative, GTM, Sales Operations and external retail partners.
You'll be the key marketing relationship for important retail accounts and distributors, translating commercial objectives into compelling retail experiences and campaigns.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Developing and executing EMEA retail channel marketing strategies, programmes and co- marketing campaigns.
- Building trusted, commercially focused relationships with major retail partners, regional and national accounts and distributors.
- Managing retail marketing budgets and co-marketing investment, ensuring spend is disciplined, effective and delivers measurable return.
- Owning the end-to-end delivery of retail marketing assets and brand collateral, from briefing and approval through to production and execution.
- Analysing campaign and channel performance using metrics including conversion, CPC, CPA, LTV and ROAS, identifying opportunities to continually improve performance.
- Supporting and developing impactful in-store experiences, including permanent fixtures, temporary displays and retail staff education and training.
- Working across multiple EMEA markets, navigating different retail environments, cultures and commercial requirements.
- Acting as a strong voice for retail within the wider marketing organisation while ensuring close alignment with commercial teams.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who combines strong retail marketing expertise with commercial and analytical thinking.

You'll ideally bring:
- 6+ years' experience in retail channel marketing, partner marketing or a closely related discipline.
- A strong understanding of retail economics, channel performance and marketing ROI.
- Experience managing retail marketing budgets and co-marketing investment.
- A proven track record of working directly with retail partners, distributors or major accounts.
- Experience delivering campaigns and brand activations across multiple markets.
- Practical experience with in-store displays, fixtures, retail experiences and/or staff training programmes.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to make commercial decisions.
- Excellent stakeholder and relationship-management skills, with the confidence to influence senior internal and external stakeholders.
- Outstanding project management skills and an eye for detail, particularly when managing multiple markets, assets and deadlines simultaneously.
- The flexibility and enthusiasm to travel regularly across EMEA.
- Experience within consumer technology or another fast-growth consumer category would be highly advantageous, as would experience working with distributor models.
- Additional EMEA language skills would also be welcomed.

What Will Make You Successful?

This is a role where influence matters as much as authority.
You'll need to be comfortable operating in a fast-moving, matrixed environment where priorities can change quickly and where success depends on bringing multiple teams and external partners together.
You'll be naturally curious and commercially minded, able to move comfortably between strategy and execution. You'll care about the detail, but always understand the bigger picture.
Most importantly, you'll be someone who builds excellent relationships - both internally and with retail partners - and who is motivated by creating marketing programmes that genuinely move the needle.

Why Join?

This is a chance to join a rapidly growing, global consumer technology business at an important stage of its international expansion.
You'll have genuine scope to influence how the brand is represented across EMEA retail, work with high- profile commercial partners and help build the marketing infrastructure required to support continued growth.
It's a highly visible role with the opportunity to influence regional retail strategy, develop relationships across the business and potentially help shape the future growth of the retail marketing function.

You'll join a collaborative, values-led and mission-driven environment where people are encouraged to take ownership, move quickly and make a meaningful impact.
London-based with a hybrid working model.

Ready to shape the next chapter of EMEA retail growth?
If you're an ambitious retail marketer who thrives on commercial challenge, enjoys working with major retail partners and wants the opportunity to make a genuine regional impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Proven ability to create and optimise content that has improved organic rankings, traffic, visibility or engagement

Strong editorial and copywriting skills, with the ability to produce clear, helpful and engaging content

title: SEO Lead
description:
Reed.co.uk is looking for an SEO Lead to join their team in Holborn, London.

Overview

Reed.co.uk is one of the UK's leading job sites, appearing in over 1 billion job searches annually and connecting millions of candidates with employers across the country. We're looking for an experienced SEO Lead to take ownership of our day-to-day SEO performance and help drive sustainable organic growth across Reed.co.uk.

This is a highly collaborative role for someone who will be an SEO champion within the business. You'll proactively monitor our organic performance, identify opportunities and risks, and turn SEO insight into clear recommendations and priorities. Working closely with our external SEO consultant and Digital PR agency, you'll collaborate across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Content and Marketing to ensure SEO is considered in relevant decisions and opportunities are successfully delivered.

Traditional search will remain at the heart of the role. You'll also help us understand and respond to the evolving landscape of AI-powered search and LLM visibility, ensuring Reed.co.uk is well positioned as candidate search behaviours develop.

Key Responsibilities
- Champion SEO across Reed.co.uk, ensuring organic search is understood and considered in relevant product, content and technology decisions.
- Proactively monitor and analyse organic search performance, identifying changes, risks and growth opportunities and translating these into clear recommendations and priorities.
- Own the day-to-day SEO operation, setting clear briefs and priorities, challenging recommendations where appropriate and holding teams accountable for high-quality delivery and results.
- Work closely with our SEO consultant to help translate SEO strategy into a clear, actionable roadmap and identify opportunities to improve performance.
- Partner with Product, Engineering and Delivery teams to embed SEO best practice, provide input into new products and site changes, and ensure SEO requirements are understood and successfully implemented.
- Identify and diagnose technical SEO opportunities and issues across areas including crawling, indexing, site architecture, internal linking and structured data, working with Engineering on implementation.
- Work collaboratively with Content and Marketing teams on keyword research, search demand, content optimisation, competitor analysis and opportunities to strengthen organic visibility.
- Monitor search engine developments, competitor activity and emerging AI search and LLM discovery trends, identifying opportunities to test, learn and evolve our approach.

Skills & Experience
- 4-5+ years of SEO experience, with a strong background on technical and on-page SEO and knowledge of Digital PR and how it complements SEO efforts.
- A proven track record of using SEO insight and recommendations to improve organic performance on medium to large sites, e-commerce or platforms with short lived content.
- Good technical SEO knowledge, including crawling and indexing, site architecture, internal linking, structured data and rendering JavaScript / dynamic content with the ability to work effectively with Engineering teams on implementation.
- Strong analytical skills and experience using platforms such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics and enterprise SEO and crawling tools to understand performance, test and discover issues.
- Experience managing SEO agencies or specialist partners, with the confidence to set priorities, challenge recommendations and drive high-quality delivery.
- Excellent communication, collaboration and project management skills, with experience influencing Product, Engineering and other non-SEO stakeholders and translating SEO requirements into clear business recommendations.
- A proactive and commercially minded approach, with the curiosity to investigate performance changes, identify opportunities and prioritise activity according to likely business impact.
- A good foundational understanding of AI-powered search, LLMs and emerging approaches to search visibility, alongside a genuine curiosity to develop your knowledge as the landscape evolves.

Additional Requirements
- Must be located in and eligible to work in the UK
- Must have a 2:1 degree or equivalent (e.g. apprenticeship)

Benefits
- Hybrid working

- Flexible holiday scheme (buy, sell and carry over your holiday)

title: Marketing Graduate
description:
Marketing Graduate

Fully funded Marketing qualification Monthly bonus Croydon Mon-Fri

Think creatively. Act commercially. Deliver results.

Overview of the position

Redwood is seeking a creative and commercially minded Marketing Graduate to join a structured development programme combining formal training, hands-on experience, cross-departmental exposure and increasing responsibility.

During the first 12 months, you will complete the Marketing Graduate Scheme and marketing qualification, developing the practical, technical and commercial skills needed to take a marketing brief from concept through to delivery. The remaining 12 months will focus on applying and developing these skills within the Marketing team.

Why we exist

At Redwood, we believe debt collection should empower businesses, not burden them. Our mission is to help clients grow stronger by taking on the responsibility of debt recovery, allowing them to focus on growing their business.

How we achieve our mission

Working with the Marketing Team and colleagues across Redwood, you will support live marketing activity while developing your skills through structured training, practical projects and regular feedback.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Content creation

Support content across websites, social media, email and other channels, adapting messaging for different audiences and Redwood's tone of voice.
- Campaign support & delivery

Assist with marketing campaigns across organic and paid channels, supporting lead generation and commercial objectives.
- Analytics and insight

Monitor marketing performance using analytics, CRM reporting and campaign data to support future activity.
- Email marketing

Support email campaigns, customer journeys, audience segmentation and CRM activity.
- Projects & cross-functional collaboration

Work with teams across Redwood on marketing projects, events and initiatives, taking increasing ownership as you develop.

What will you bring?

You are naturally curious, creative and keen to build a career in marketing. You are willing to learn, comfortable receiving feedback and interested in understanding how marketing supports a commercial business.
- Education & interest in marketing: Ideally, you will hold a 2:1 or above degree in Marketing, Business or a related subject; with a genuine interest in marketing demonstrated through studies, projects or other activities.
- Portfolio & creativity: A portfolio of relevant work from university, college, placements, internships, employment or projects completed in your own time.
- Communication & attention to detail: Strong written and verbal communication skills, and ability to produce accurate, high-quality work.
- Initiative & development: Able to interpret briefs, use initiative, develop ideas and positively apply constructive feedback.
- Organisation & ownership: Organised, able to manage deadlines and willing to take increasing responsibility for your work.
- Commercial awareness: Interested in Redwood's services, audiences and objectives, with the ability to work collaboratively across the business.

The Graduate Scheme

The first 12 months will follow a structured development plan, with formal reviews at six, nine and twelve months in addition to Redwood's standard three-month probation process.

As part of the scheme, you will work towards a recognised marketing qualification alongside structured internal training and practical, on-the-job development. Training will cover marketing systems and platforms, brand and content, commercial knowledge and cross-departmental exposure. You will work with colleagues across the business to understand Redwood's services, audiences and commercial objectives.

The marketing qualification will be fully funded by Redwood, subject to a training repayment agreement. Repayment obligations will apply if you leave within the first 24 months of employment, with full terms provided separately.

The scheme is designed to develop the skills and experience required to progress towards a Marketing Executive-level position, subject to successful completion, performance and business requirements.

What we believe in

At Redwood, our purpose is grounded in our values:
- We are dedicated: We go beyond just delivering results - we deliver the best possible experience.
- We are respectful: We understand our clients' needs. Handling even the most difficult situations with professionalism
- We make it easy: By taking on the burden of debt recovery, we empower our clients to focus on growing their business.
- We succeed together: We work as a team, both internally and with our clients, because we believe in shared success.

The details

Competitive salary plus monthly company performance bonus, payable following a 12-month qualifying period.

20 days paid holiday per annum (incentive to increase).

Hours: Monday to Friday 8:30 - 17:00

Contract: 24-month fixed-term contract

Location: Airport House, Croydon, CR0 0 XZ

How to Apply

Please submit your CV along with a portfolio showcasing examples of your work as part of your application.

NB: Due to high application volumes, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Here at South Thames Colleges Group, we are seeking a Marketing Manager to co-ordinate all marketing, promotional and publicity activities geared towards meeting the Group's strategic objectives.

As Marketing Manager, you will plan, deliver and evaluate a range of marketing and communications campaigns that support student recruitment, engagement and the wider strategic objectives of the Group. Working across all four Colleges, you will manage integrated campaigns across digital, advertising, PR, publications, events and promotional activity, ensuring a consistent and engaging brand presence.

You will work closely with curriculum teams, students and colleagues to develop compelling content, success stories and campaigns that showcase student experiences, achievements and career outcomes. You will also coordinate high-profile recruitment and College events, including open days, exhibitions and VIP visits. Using digital platforms and campaign insights, you will monitor and evaluate marketing performance, using data to continually improve activity, strengthen the Colleges' reputation and support recruitment targets.

We are looking for an experienced marketing professional with a strong track record of planning, implementing and evaluating successful marketing and communications campaigns within a large, customer-focused organisation. You will bring strong digital marketing expertise, an understanding of how to use an effective marketing mix to meet objectives, and experience of managing projects and campaigns to tight deadlines.

You will be an excellent communicator with strong copywriting and content skills, able to build effective relationships and influence a wide range of internal and external stakeholders. You will also be able to think strategically, bringing fresh ideas and using insight to develop marketing activity that delivers measurable results.

Please note, this role is predominantly based at Kingston College, but you will be required to work from all STCG sites.

Closing date for the return of an online application form is 9th November 2026

The benefits package includes generous annual leave of 37 days, plus up to 8 additional days over Christmas/New Year as well as an additional 5 days Wellbeing leave to enhance employees' physical and mental health. This leave is all in addition to Bank Holiday entitlement. There is an excellent pension scheme that receives a significant financial contribution from the employer (Teachers Pensions or Local Government Pension Scheme), subsidised sports facilities and professional development and training plus a salary sacrifice cycle to work scheme.

South Thames Colleges Group is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults.

As outlined in the Public Sector Equality Duty of the Equality Act 2010, we are committed to equality of opportunity for all staff and applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships.

As part of our due diligence checks on prospective employees, successful candidates will be subject to an enhanced DBS check, satisfactory references, an online search and proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

The South Thames Colleges Group is made up of Carshalton College, Kingston College, Merton College and South Thames College, which merged on 1 August 2017. South Thames Colleges Group is one of London's largest providers of post-16 education and training and is an ongoing and significant contributor to its local communities. We aim to put students' success at the heart of everything we do.

We are looking for hard-working and collaborative people who can join our team and help challenge our students to progress and achieve.

title: Social Media Manager - Paid & Organic
description:
Paid social will be your specialism, but you'll be confident working across organic content too.

We're looking for a social media all-rounder with genuine paid campaign expertise: someone who can confidently plan, build and optimise paid activity, but who also enjoys developing organic content, contributing ideas and being part of the wider social conversation.

Reporting to our Head of Social Media, you'll take ownership of paid social campaigns for a varied portfolio of established B2 B brands, while working alongside our social, PR & creative teams to deliver effective content across the full social mix. It's an ideal role for someone who enjoys the performance and precision of paid media, but does not want to spend everyday solely inside Ads Manager.

About the role
- Paid social leadership: Plan, build, manage and optimise campaigns across Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and TikTok, focused on objectives including lead generation, brand visibility and website traffic.
- Campaign delivery: Take hands-on responsibility for campaign structure, audience targeting, budgets, bidding, testing, ad copy and creative briefs.
- Performance and insight: Monitor results, identify opportunities and turn campaign data into clear, practical recommendations for clients and colleagues.
- Client advice: Provide informed guidance on paid strategy, platform selection and best practice.
- Organic content: Develop platform-appropriate ideas and copy, create and edit mobile-first video, and schedule timely content aligned with each client's brand.
- Community management: Help clients build stronger online communities by engaging with audiences and responding appropriately to comments and messages.
- Collaboration: Work with our full team to integrate paid and organic social into wider campaigns.
- Growth: Contribute ideas to pitches and proposals, and help identify new opportunities for clients and the agency.

What you'll need
- At least two years' hands-on experience planning, building and optimising paid social campaigns.
- Strong working knowledge of Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and TikTok advertising platforms, including lead-generation campaigns.
- A sound understanding of campaign structure, audience building, segmentation, testing, budgets and funnel optimisation.
- The confidence to interpret data, improve performance and explain results clearly to clients, both via Teams meetings and in-person.
- Evidence that you can also create effective organic social content, including strong copy and short-form video.
